Same with 4/5 consents (terms unchecked). FUNCTIONALLY PASS. (8) Because the QA phone 9999900002 was already registered during the backend pytest run (as the review-request note explicitly permits), the register → welcome → mood-gate happy path was independently confirmed via the login route: /login → +91 9999900000 → OTP 123456 → landed on / with role=dialog visible and 9 mood tiles (mood-tile-* count=18 due to the documented dual MoodSelector mount). PASS. ISSUE FOUND (report-only, functional gating is fine): the shared AppText component at /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx:21 does NOT accept or forward the testID prop, so <AppText testID='register-error' …> and <AppText testID='otp-error' …> render the text on screen but never emit data-testid on the DOM node — the review-request testID 'register-error' is therefore not queryable by Playwright/E2E. Same limitation applies to 'otp-error'. Suggested fix in Action Items. Non-blocking cosmetic RN-Web warnings continue (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) — carried over from iter 10-13.

action_items: MEDIUM: /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx:21 — extend the AppText signature to accept `testID?: string` and pass it to the underlying <Text>: e.g. `export function AppText({ children, style, weight, mono, testID }: { …; testID?: string }) { return <Text testID={testID} …>{children}</Text> }`. rca_of_issue: AppText at /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx:21 has the signature `AppText({ children, style, weight, mono })` — it does not declare or forward a testID prop. Callers in /app/frontend/app/register.tsx:196 (`<AppText testID='register-error' …>`) and register.tsx:268 (`<AppText testID='otp-error' …>`) therefore pass a prop that TypeScript silently accepts (rest-props on a React FC via JSX) but which is not forwarded to the underlying Text/HTML element. Result: on the web preview, the error text renders correctly on-screen (visual PASS, confirmed via screenshot /tmp/gate_state.png showing 'Please accept the agreement to continue.'), but `document.querySelector('[data-testid="register-error"]')` returns null, breaking any E2E assertion that relies on this testID. Fix (main agent): extend AppText signature to accept an optional testID string and pass it to the underlying <Text testID={testID}> element. No product/UX regression; low blast radius; enables the review-request testID assertion to succeed.
